description: Use when creating a new Experience Cloud site: selecting LWR vs Aura template, configuring branding and navigation, setting up a custom domain, and using Experience Builder. Trigger keywords: create new Experience Cloud site, LWR vs Aura template, set up community portal domain, Experience Builder page builder, branding sets, navigation menu configuration, Microsite LWR, Build Your Own LWR. NOT for coding LWR themes or custom components — use lwc/lwr-site-development. NOT for deploying a finished site to another org — use devops/experience-cloud-deployment-admin. Also covers the deployable metadata: Network, CustomSite, NavigationMenu, ExperienceBundle, DigitalExperienceBundle, urlPathPrefix, networkMemberGroups, emailSenderAddress, site status Live vs UnderConstruction.
inputs: Target audience for the site (customers, partners, employees)
Required component types (LWC-only vs mixed Aura/LWC)
Custom domain name and My Domain configuration
Edition confirmation (Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, or Developer)
name: experience-cloud-site-setup
official_sources: LWR Sites for Experience Cloud (v66.0, Spring '26) — LWR vs Aura template comparison, publish model, performance behavior, LWR template limitations
Salesforce Help: Custom Domain for Experience Cloud — Custom domain pattern (`MyDomainName.my.site.com`), My Domain requirement
Salesforce Help: Experience Builder — Page builder, navigation menu configuration, branding sets, site publishing

Metadata API Developer Guide, `Network` (Summer '26 / v62, api_meta.txt L90671–L92035) — Required fields (`emailSenderAddress`, `emailSenderName`, `forgotPasswordTemplate`, `site`, `status`, `tabs`), the write-once behaviour of `emailSenderAddress` (L90784–L90795), the `Live` / `DownForMaintenance` / `UnderConstruction` status enum (L91054–L91074), `networkMemberGroups` and its Chatter-customer carve-out (L90963–L90970), `selfRegistration` / `selfRegProfile` (L91035–L91042), `urlPathPrefix` (L91084–L91089), `maxFileSizeKb` (L90936–L90941) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

Metadata API Developer Guide, `CustomSite` (api_meta.txt L46743–L47235) — the Security pillar's site-container controls: `clickjackProtectionLevel` values and the "(recommended)" annotation on `SameOriginOnly` (L46876–L46888), `requireHttps` removed in API 52.0 and ignored earlier (L47015–L47017), `redirectToCustomDomain` defaulting to `false` in Experience Cloud sites (L46982–L46989), `allowStandardPortalPages` as an access control (L46796–L46804), and `guestProfile` / `subdomain` being Read only (L46959, L47059)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `NavigationMenu` and `NavigationMenuItem` (api_meta.txt L90445–L90668) — the five valid item types and their `target` rules (L90515–L90564), `publiclyAvailable` as a menu-visibility flag rather than a permission (L90509–L90510), and the note that Help Center and LWR templates ship no generic record pages (L90449–L90452)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `ExperienceBundle` (api_meta.txt L59875–L61121), `DigitalExperienceBundle` (L51103–L51375) and `DigitalExperienceConfig` (L53950–L54050) — which bundle type applies to which site vintage and the packaging restriction on enhanced LWR (L51234–L51238), `brandingSetType` and the fixed `definitionName` values per standard template (L59996–L60019), the `SiteDotCom`-in-manifest exclusion (L61110), and the cross-API-version deploy sequence (L61111–L61115)

Object Reference, `Network` and `NetworkMember` (Summer '26 / v62, object_reference.txt L186629–L188420) — Setup labels for the status values (Published / Offline / Preview) and the one-way nature of `UnderConstruction` (L187347–L187373), `UrlPathPrefix` carrying the `Update` property (L187375–L187378), and the supported calls on both objects that make membership a consequence rather than an insert (L186636–L186637, L188301–L188302) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf
